subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about the JavaScript editor and using proper syntax to code your projects with text

questions.hint: Which line of code sets the sprite’s velocity?
questions.title:
[Select one] Which line of code sets the sprite to move on its own?

﻿
questions.correctResponse: mySprite.setVelocity(50, 50) sets a sprite’s velocity so it moves on its own.

questions.hint: Where do errors appear in the JavaScript editor?
questions.title: [Select one] The JavaScript editor tells you if there are errors in your code.
questions.correctResponse: Clicking Problems on the bottom of the JavaScript editor will reveal the error message.

questions.hint: How are names formatted in camelCase?
questions.title: [Select one] Which of the sprite names below are written in camelCase?
questions.correctResponse: Remember, camelCase places a capital letter where a space should be.

questions.hint: What else is important to remember when coding in JavaScript?
questions.title: [Select one] Which of these matter in JavaScript?
questions.correctResponse: Capitalization, symbols, and spacing are all part of syntax which is important in JavaScript!

questions.title: [Open response] What are you excited to code using JavaScript?
questions.correctResponse: Those sound like great ideas! Excited to see what you create using JavaScript in Blue Belt!

subgroups.title: JavaScript Syntax!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about the JavaScript editor and using proper syntax to code your projects with text

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Blue Belt! In this level, you’ll move from using blocks to code to using JavaScript, and learn about JavaScript code and syntax! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: And Now For Something New
badges.description: Use the MakeCode JavaScript editor to add sprites and set their properties.

badges.title: Opening Line
badges.description: Write your first line of JavaScript code.

badges.title: Coordinating Coordinates
badges.description: Set a sprite’s position in JavaScript.

badges.title: String Theory
badges.description: Add a string to a function’s parameter in JavaScript.

badges.title: Palette Cleanser
badges.description: Use a number to set the background color of a scene in JavaScript.

badges.title: Truth Hurts
badges.description: Use a Boolean value to set a sprite’s property in JavaScript.

badges.title: Gaining a Following
badges.description: Set a sprite to follow another sprite in JavaScript.
